scene: A carved cork bung seals glowing blue liquid bubbling inside the barrel.
picture: First-person close-up view of the top of the oak barrel. On the left, a wooden bung seals the bubbling blue ink. In the centre, a ticking round brass pressure gauge shows high pressure. On the right, a rusty spanner lies on the dark wooden rim. Blue droplets steam gently upward.
shown: a carved wooden bung jammed tight in the barrel lid on the left
a tarnished brass pressure dial ticking rapidly in the centre
a rusty metal spanner resting on the rim to the right
